_doc: FILL-2018 insurer cells (11) — REFUSED, with the blocker identified. Investigated 2026-08-11 after the vision rung closed. The blocker is NOT document access: all four companies have text-bearing year-later filings on BSE with 8-12 consolidated pages each (GICRE ann 20190814 30p/67k chars, NIACL ann 20200211 44p, HDFCLIFE ann 20191023 84p, ICICIPRULI ann 20190424 73p). The blocker is that OUR OWN STORED STANDALONE REVENUE FOR THESE COMPANIES CANNOT BE RECONCILED TO THOSE FILINGS, which removes the control every §55 insurer read depends on. §55's whole safety argument is the per-filing standalone control plus the con/std ratio family; with an unreconcilable standalone, a consolidated figure read from the document would be written beside a standalone on a DIFFERENT basis — the cross-basis inconsistency §40b exists to prevent. Landing them needs the insurer revenue basis re-derived first (the §43 IRDAI public-disclosures route plus a basis audit), which is its own campaign, not a fill.

NIACL.verdict: our stored figures do not appear in the filing AT ALL
NIACL.detail: The Dec-2019 filing (BSE ann, 44 pages, standalone Annexure-1 on p1, consolidated on p21) prints, in lakhs, for the 31/12/2018 column: Gross Premiums Written 6,78,023 · Net Premium written 5,32,296 · Premium Earned (Net) 5,50,306 · Income from investments 85,429 · Total income (3to5) 6,35,735. Our stored revS for 20181231 is 5,993.52 cr = 5,99,352 lakh, which matches NONE of them. A full-text search of the filing for 837286 / 840607 / 599352 (our stored 2019-12 revS, our 2019-12 revC and our 2018-12 revS) returns ZERO occurrences.
NIACL.consequence: NIACL was the ONE insurer whose stored series is otherwise clean (38 quarters, no duplicates, nothing out of family) and whose 2018-12 con/std PAT separation of 2.26% is wide enough for an anchor. It was the best candidate and it still cannot be gated.

GICRE.verdict: stored standalone series is itself defective, and the con PAT is a copy
GICRE.detail: The Jun-2019 filing prints standalone Total income (3+4+5) of 17,82,776 lakh = 17,827.76 cr for the quarter, against our stored revS for 20190630 of 1,418.65 — off by 12.6x. Our four stored FY19 quarters sum to 44,080.43 against the filing's printed FY19 total income of 42,527.93 (3.6% apart). Separately, GICRE's stored con PAT EQUALS std PAT to the paisa for 23 CONSECUTIVE quarters (2016-06 -> 2021-12) and then differs by 0.24-44.4% from 2022-03 onward and never returns — the §55c COPY class, bounded by measurement this campaign.
GICRE.consequence: no usable PAT anchor AND no usable standalone control. Its 3 cells are held twice over.

ICICIPRULI.verdict: stored standalone series carries the §55b column-misalignment fingerprint TWICE, and both pairs land in the 2018 window
ICICIPRULI.detail: stored revS 20180930 == 20181231 == 8,530.72 to the paisa, and stored revS 20180630 == 20190630 == 8,199.68 to the paisa. Two quarters of one company reporting the same revenue to the paisa is §55b's misalignment fingerprint; here it happens twice and covers three of the four target quarters. Its con/std PAT separation is 0.09-0.22%, far inside close()'s 0.4% band, so a PAT anchor cannot separate the bases either (§76b).
ICICIPRULI.consequence: all 4 cells held; the standalone side needs repair before the consolidated side can be read.

HDFCLIFE.verdict: no tell inside the 2018 window, but no anchor either
HDFCLIFE.detail: stored series shows two out-of-family quarters (20161231, 20200331) but neither is in the target window. The blocker here is the anchor: con/std PAT separation is 0.37% (2018-09) and 0.43% (2018-12), inside close()'s 0.4% band, so §76b's cross-basis gate cannot prove a column belongs to the consolidated basis rather than the standalone one.
HDFCLIFE.consequence: 2 cells held pending either a reconciled standalone basis or a wider anchor.

Correct behaviour: insurers file in IRDAI format and 'Net Sales/Income from operations' is simply not the quantity we store for them
year-later BSE filing (the triage that closed the vision rung) — documents FOUND and text-bearing for all four, rows located and read; refused at the CONTROL stage, not the fetch stage
§64 — NIACL 2018-09 has no stored con PAT at all, so no anchored reader can reach it regardless
next_rung_not_walked: §43 IRDAI public disclosures — the one route that could establish what our stored insurer revenue basis actually IS. Recommended as the start of a separate insurer-basis campaign, since it must fix the STANDALONE side before any consolidated cell is safe.
